title: Ready for IELTS Student's Book with Answers
description: Comprehensive preparation course for students aiming for IELTS Bands 6.5 to 8. Includes extensive practice for Academic Reading, Writing, Listening and Speaking with model answers, CD audio scripts, and exam advice.

title: The Official Cambridge Guide to IELTS for Academic & General Training
authors: Pauline Cullen; Amanda French; Vanessa Jakeman
description: The definitive guide to IELTS from the organization that produces the exam. Features step-by-step guidance for every paper, strategy advice from experienced examiners, and 8 full official practice tests.

title: English Grammar in Use with Answers
description: The world's best-selling grammar reference and practice book for intermediate English learners. Renowned for its clear two-page format with explanations on the left and exercises on the right.

title: Oxford English Grammar Course: Intermediate
description: A comprehensive grammar course from Oxford University Press designed to help intermediate learners understand how grammar works in authentic contexts with engaging illustrations and short texts.

title: Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary (10th Edition)
description: The world's bestselling advanced learner's dictionary. Builds English vocabulary with over 60,000 words, 109,000 examples, CEFR level tags, Oxford 3000/5000 core word lists, and pronunciation guide.

title: English File: Intermediate Student's Book
description: Oxford's flagship communicative English course that gets students talking. Features balanced lessons in grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and skills with authentic video listening materials.

title: Oxford Bookworms Library: Stage 3 Box Collection
description: A curated box set of classic and contemporary graded readers at Stage 3 (1000 headwords, B1 CEFR level). Perfect for building reading speed, vocabulary retention, and reading fluency.

title: Minna no Nihongo I: Second Edition (Main Textbook)
description: The premier Japanese language textbook used worldwide for beginners. Establishes core Japanese grammar, everyday conversational patterns, Hiragana/Katakana sentence building, and JLPT N5 foundational skills.

title: Genki I: An Integrated Course in Elementary Japanese (Third Edition)
authors: Eriko Banno; Yoko Ikeda; Yutaka Ohno
description: A highly acclaimed comprehensive introductory course in elementary Japanese. Features engaging dialogues, grammar explanations in English, vocabulary lists, and integrated cultural notes.

title: Easy Spanish Step-by-Step
description: A fast, proven approach to learning Spanish through grammar-first principles. Starts with high-frequency nouns and essential verbs, advancing gradually to sentence construction and conversation.

title: Practice Makes Perfect: Complete French All-in-One
description: The ultimate all-in-one guide to French grammar, vocabulary, verbs, and conversation. Seven complete books in one comprehensive volume with online audio exercises via the McGraw Hill Language Lab app.

title: A Little History of the World
description: E. H. Gombrich's masterly, lyrical chronological history of humanity from the Stone Age to the atomic era. Illustrated and translated into over thirty languages, it is an international classic of historical storytelling.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
description: A groundbreaking exploration of how Homo sapiens came to conquer Earth through cognitive, agricultural, and scientific revolutions. Examines money, religion, science, and the future of our species.

title: The Silk Roads: A New History of the World
description: An ambitious reappraisal of world history centering the Eurasian trade networks that connected East and West. Peter Frankopan traces the rise of empires, religions, and modern global commerce.

title: Guns Germs and Steel: The Fates of Human Societies
description: Winner of the Pulitzer Prize, Jared Diamond examines how geographic, environmental, and ecological factors shaped the unequal distribution of wealth, technology, and power across human civilizations.

title: A History of the World in 100 Objects
description: Former British Museum Director Neil MacGregor tells the history of humanity through 100 artifacts spanning two million years, from the earliest stone cutting tool to modern solar powered lamps.

title: SPQR: A History of Ancient Rome
description: Renowned classicist Mary Beard provides a fresh, authoritative narrative of Rome's thousand-year rise from an obscure muddy village into a dominant world superpower governing fifty million people.

title: How Not to Be Wrong: The Power of Mathematical Thinking
description: Mathematician Jordan Ellenberg demonstrates how mathematical thinking clarifies real-world problems in politics, elections, medicine, lotteries, and public policy with humor and clarity.

title: Calculus: Early Transcendentals (8th Edition)
description: The gold standard calculus textbook in colleges worldwide. Famous for its mathematical precision, conceptual clarity, outstanding problem sets, and real-world engineering and scientific applications.

title: A Mind for Numbers: How to Excel at Math and Science
description: Engineering professor Barbara Oakley reveals neuroscientific learning techniques to master mathematics and difficult scientific subjects, conquer procrastination, and unlock conceptual breakthrough understanding.

title: Linear Algebra Done Right (Undergraduate Texts in Mathematics)
description: A celebrated modern approach to linear algebra focusing on vector spaces and linear maps before introducing determinants. Ideal for undergraduates studying pure mathematics, physics, and computer science.

title: Campbell Biology (11th Edition)
authors: Lisa A. Urry; Michael L. Cain; Steven A. Wasserman; Peter V. Minorsky
description: The world's leading introductory biology textbook for university students. Comprehensive coverage of cell biology, genetics, evolutionary theory, plant physiology, animal anatomy, and ecology.

title: The Selfish Gene: 40th Anniversary Edition
description: Richard Dawkins's classic work introducing the gene-centered view of evolution and coining the word 'meme'. An essential foundation for understanding evolutionary biology, animal behavior, and altruism.

title: Molecular Biology of the Cell (6th Edition)
authors: Bruce Alberts; Alexander Johnson; Julian Lewis; David Morgan
description: The definitive, landmark textbook of cellular and molecular biology. Explains DNA replication, protein synthesis, cellular transport, signaling pathways, and developmental biology with detailed scientific rigor.
